rationale: This condition establishes an observable baseline from which a withdrawal-related drop can be detected. It gates starting the mapped procedure; measuring that baseline does not change the removal/restoration mechanism, justify causal attribution, or alter the target. The currently unestablished baseline does not invalidate the coherent prospective procedure.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Fix the activation definition and observation window before withdrawal, then measure completion in the full design to establish whether enough activation occurs for a drop to be detectable.
